thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem. Root cause looks like aggressive KV cache eviction (memory-limiter change) + rollout that increased average seq len -> much more KV churn and tail latency. We need explicit owners + short timelines for remediation and to add tests so this doesn't slip back in.

Proposed items (initial):
- regression prompt set that reproduces long-seq behavior + assertions
- load test profile (steady-state + burst) hitting cache thresholds
- chaos drill that simulates node eviction and verifies model fallback
- perf-guard metric + alert on KV-evict rate / cache-hit drops
- lightweight canary with automatic fallback to smaller variant

Can people volunteer owners and ETA? I'll compile an action tracker once owners confirm.

alex: I can own the regression prompt set + CI asserts. Will pull examples from the incident traces and the customer prompt samples.
Metrics I'll assert in CI: p95_token_latency <= baseline*1.5, kv_evicts_per_min <= X, cache_hit_ratio >= Y.
ETA: 2026-04-04. I'll open a PR with the promptset and a small harness. :+1:

sam: I'll take load testing and the ramp/burst profiles. Plan to use k6 for steady-state + custom burst script to reproduce the eviction behavior.
Question: where should the artifacts/live results go? Suggest s3://redwood-evals/incident-1769200000/loadtests.
ETA: 2026-04-08. I'll add a nightly job for the heavy runs; keep CI light.

rachel: I'll own the chaos drill and runbook. Runbook will include safe steps to force cache pressure on a canary, verify fallback, and roll back.
I'll schedule a tabletop first (incl. oncall + infra + eng-ml), then one live drill on canary infra.
Tabletop ETA: 2026-04-12. Live drill ETA: 2026-04-19.

dante: I'll add the perf-guard alert and a dashboard tile for kv_evict_rate and cache_hit_ratio. I'll also hook an automation to create a regression ticket when thresholds are exceeded for >5m.
ETA: 2026-03-29.

ops-bot: Created ticket RED-1769200000 in remediation board for initial tracking.

maya: Awesome, thanks. A few implementation notes:
- keep the CI regression promptset small (10-20 prompts) with synthetic long-token sequences so it runs fast (<3m). Heavy loads and full promptset live in nightly/schedule.
- include a simple reproducible local script so SEs can debug without full infra. e.g.:
```bash
# repro: small-model, local kv pressure
python tools/repro_kv_eviction.py --model small-v1 --seq-len 2048 --concurrency 8 --duration 120
```
- for load tests, include a profile that ramps from 10qps -> 300qps in 5m and holds bursts of 600qps for 30s.

alex: noted on the small CI set. I'll add threshold asserts and a pointer to the heavy promptset in the PR.

sam: I'll create the s3 path and post link when ready. Also will add k6 scripts to infra repo.

rachel: I'll add contact list + rollback checklist in the runbook. Please @mention me in any test failures so I can triage.

dante: dashboards + alert rule will be in observability (dashboards/redwood/kv-evict). I'll post the link once deployed.

maya: I'll create the consolidated action-tracker doc and link each PR/ticket. Please drop the initial PR/ticket links here when you have them.

alex: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/pulls/4521 (promptset + CI harness)
sam: Load artifacts s3 path ready: s3://redwood-evals/incident-1769200000/loadtests; PR coming.
rachel: Tabletop scheduled 2026-04-12 16:00 UTC (calendar invite sent).
dante: Dashboard published: https://obs.redwood.ai/d/kv-evict (view-only for now).

maya: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the remediation action items. I'll update the tracker with these PR/links and the dates.

(emoji reactions: :white_check_mark: :spiral_calendar: :construction:)
